prompt: Move task t7 to review with exactly this note: abc1234
note: Behavioral outcome UNMEASURED: no model run was made. Confusable control for scheduler-decision-note-positive: when the user supplies the note text, the agent must pass it verbatim and must not expand it into a decision note. Two distinct outcomes are graded separately. Exact note: the executions expectation requires one direct task-review.sh run whose arguments are exactly t7 and abc1234 and that reported an error (reported_error: a correlated native tool error or a real nonzero exit). It asserts no numeric exit status, because the portable Claude adapter reports none for a failed call; a run with an expanded note has different arguments and does not count. Fail-closed outcome: the reply must name SESSION_SCHEDULER_HOME (the runner must NOT pre-export it). The case does not show that the note was stored verbatim, because the fail-closed path writes nothing; a stored-note check needs a runner-provided scheduler home on both providers.
